rules.statement: A party can lead oral evidence to prove the true nature of a transaction, even if it contradicts a statement in a written contract, particularly when seeking equity.
rules.supporting_quote: "The principle of English equity was that he who sought equity must do it. In this case the plaintiff comes into Court repudiating a statement with regard to the payment of the consideration, and if he is allowed to put that forward, he ought also to suffer the person whom he attacks to show the real nature of the transaction."
